summary: Iteration 5: verified new Session Notes feature + Share to chat button. Backend notes round-trip test added (create/get/update, default empty). Frontend tested end-to-end: filling input-notes on New Session persists and renders in summary-note block on /summary/:id; sessions without a note render NO summary-note block. Share-image-button in headless Chromium correctly falls back to PNG download (filename courtsplit-<slug>-<date>.png). Save image still downloads PNG. Copy link writes correct URL to clipboard. Verified via PIL that exported PNG: width 880, height 1840 (vs 1700 without note = +140px note area), top pixel is emerald gradient (9,149,122), bottom is slate-900 footer (15,23,42), and emerald-50 note background pixels present just above the footer. No unhandled page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Summary.jsx shareImage() silently swallows AbortError (correct) but shows generic 'Could not share image' toast on any other error; consider logging error for debugging.
imageOptions() fetches Google Fonts CSS on every download/share; could cache the result to avoid duplicate requests when a user clicks both Save and Share.
seed_data_creation: Created transient sessions during Playwright (TestArenaNote, NoNoteArena) — not cleaned; harmless test data.
